tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// khro bo rme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bhyaḥkhro bo stobs po che bsgrub par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed byas la/ rang gi snying gar hūm̐ mthing nag bsam/ de'i 'od zer gyis lus bsregs pas skyon thams cad dag nas/ sems khro bo rme brtsegs su gyur par bsam te/ de'ang sku mdog dud ka zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus dud ka zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa la/ sbrul sngon lto ba dmar ser gyis dkris shing*/ thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbur brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje rgya gram/ bar pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ tha ma rdo rje lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi dang po rdo rje dbyug pa/ bar pa rdo rje zhags pa/ tha ma rdo rje sdigs mdzub mdzad pa ste/ de thams cad gyen du bsgreng ba/ thod pa skam po'i phreng bas se ral khar byas shing yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis bgrad pas nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sku las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba bskyed la/ lha'i sku de nyid la dmigs pa gtad la/ sngags bzlas te/ sngags ni 'di'o// oṃ bhūr khuṃ ma hā bhra ma nā ye/ bhu tsi bhu ki bi ma le/ utstshuṣma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bhur khuṃ ri li shu tha ra sha u bi ma le/ utstshuṣma kro dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas bgegs dang log 'dren gyi gnod pa dang*/ nyams grib la sogs pa mi gtsang ba gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing*/ shin tu gtsang sbra chung bas kyang 'grub la/ 'di bsnyen bsgrub kyang mi dgos so// gzhan la phan gdags par 'dod na/ smyo 'bog can 'dul ba la/ gu gul nag po bsregs shing*/ nad pa'i snying ga na phar la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab pas gdon dang bgegs thams cad choms kyi bsregs par bsam/

des nges par phan no// ser ba bzlog par 'dod na/ sdigs mdzub sprin nag la gtad de/ sngags drag tu bzlas shing*/ sngags kyi 'od zer me lta bus bsregs par bsams na/ ser ba 'chad/ 'brug kha 'ching*/ glog lce 'chad/ thog gyen la bzlog sprin gyi gur zhig ser ba rkang 'chag go /rims nad gso na/ bum pa spos chus bkang la/ yungs kar la mang du sngags bzlas la/ bum par blugs/ nad pa la gu gul gyi dud pas bdugs ste/ bum chus phyi bkru zhing khong du btang na phan no// phyugs la god byung na/ dug sna gsum la god 'gong gi gzugs byas la/ de la god gtong ba po dgug gzhug byas la/ phur pa snying gar gdab cing*/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas btab pas phan no// phyugs nad byung na/ phyugs ra'i dbus su maṇḍal lam/ khri byas pa'i steng du/ spos chu la sngags chu btab nas gtor na phan no// mi lo nad can gso na/ shog khra la nad pa bris/ nad pa'i mal 'og tu bcug nas/ nad pa la dmigs pa gtad de sngags mang du btab na phan no// ra lug la spyang khyi byung na/ ra lug rnams kyi don pho don mo'i mgul du sngags bris la gdags/ 'bras dang lhog pa gso na/ nad pa'i sngas su gu gul bsreg cing sngags drag tu gdab bo// zhing la 'bus za na/ tshwa dang yungs kar bsregs la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab ste/ zhing gi mtha' ma bskor nas/ rlung phyogs nas sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab na gzhan du 'bros so// bang mdzod du 'gong po zhugs nas bsris la gnod na/ tsandan nam shug pa dkar po'i phur pa sor bcu gnyis pa la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab nas/ dar nag gi cod pan bcings te/ de khro bo rme brtsegs su bskyed la thod pa mtshan ngan du/ 'bru rna nag pos bkang la de la btsugs la bang mdzod du sbas na/ gnod mi nus shing bsris sme'o// 'gong po bsreg na tsher ma can gyi shing la me sbar la/ me de skad cig gis khro bo rme brtsegs su bskyed la/

de'i zhal du bgegs kyi liṅga gtubs la dbul zhing*/ sngags gsum brgya bzlas shing bsregs na phyin chad gnod mi nus so// tshar ba dang rang nyid la bstim mo// las tshogs 'di la bsnyen pa mi dgos te/ 'phral du byas pas chog phan par 'gyur ro// khro bo'i rgyal po rme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs/ rje sa skya pa'i man ngag zab mo/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
